name: cds-debug
description: Debug multiple SAP CAP services simultaneously via Cloud Foundry integration

cdsDebug.tunnelReadyTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long (in seconds) to wait for the SSH debug tunnel to become ready before reporting a connection error. Increase this value for high-latency CF regions (e.g. `ap10`, `jp10`) or slow app start-ups. Default: `30`.

cdsDebug.pauseOnBreakpoint.markdownDescription: When `Breakpoint Snapshot Handling` is enabled in the CDS Debug Settings panel, turning this on keeps the debugger paused at breakpoints. When off, CDS Debug captures breakpoint context and auto-continues. Breakpoint snapshot handling itself is off by default.

cdsDebug.breakpointSnapshotMaxEntries.markdownDescription: Maximum number of breakpoint context snapshots kept in memory for the webview list.

cdsDebug.sharedCapDebugConfig.markdownDescription: Shared fallback for `cap-debug-config.json`. When configured in user settings, CDS Debug uses this object before checking workspace `.vscode/cap-debug-config.json`. Per-service `cap-debug-config.json` files still take priority.

remoteRoot.markdownDescription: Remote source root used for generated attach configurations.

branch.markdownDescription: Default branch to use for branch preparation when no per-service `branch` is configured.

orgBranchMap.markdownDescription: Maps Cloud Foundry org names to git branches for branch preparation.
